fixed_input_class: exact Monotone 3-Sat-(2,2): every clause has exactly three distinct variables; every variable occurs exactly twice positively and twice negatively

construction: Create G_plus with one vertex for each positive clause. Each Boolean variable x occurs in exactly two positive clauses, so x becomes an edge joining those two G_plus vertices.
Create G_minus analogously from the two negative occurrences of each variable.

The edge set of G_plus and G_minus is canonically the same variable set E. Every clause has exactly three distinct variables, hence every clause-vertex has degree 3; both layers are cubic multigraphs without clause-internal loops.
dual_cubic_graph_lift.assignment_encoding: For T subseteq E, set exactly the variables in T to TRUE.
dual_cubic_graph_lift.exact_theorem: F is SAT iff there exists T subseteq E such that T is an edge cover of G_plus and E\T is an edge cover of G_minus.
proof: A positive clause is satisfied iff at least one of its three incident variable-edges belongs to T, exactly the edge-cover condition at its G_plus vertex.
A negative clause is satisfied iff at least one incident variable is FALSE, i.e. at least one incident edge belongs to E\T, exactly the edge-cover condition at its G_minus vertex.

paired_clause_terminal.predicate: For every monotone clause C={x,y,z}, the complementary clause not-C={not x,not y,not z} is also present.
paired_clause_terminal.semantic_rewrite: Each pair C AND not-C is exactly the Not-All-Equal constraint NAE(x,y,z).
paired_clause_terminal.published_theorem_used: Doecker 2019/2020 proves that this paired special case of Monotone 3-Sat-(2,2), equivalently Monotone NAE 3-SAT with exactly two appearances per variable, is always satisfiable.
paired_clause_terminal.terminal_authority: If the paired predicate holds on an exact (2,2) instance, return SAT with a constructive coloring/NAE witness route from the cited theorem.

new_invariant_coordinates.unpaired_clause_count: U(F)=number of clauses C for which the complementary clause is absent
properties: U(F)=0 is an exact polynomially recognizable SAT terminal condition on the fixed (2,2) class.
No claim is made that U strictly decreases under any currently known satisfiability-preserving transition.

next_admissible_math.question: Is there one exact polynomial operation on the dual cubic edge-cover structure that strictly decreases U(F) or another polynomial rank while preserving SAT, eventually reaching the paired-NAE terminal class or another polynomial terminal class?
